requirements.description: User wants properties near green spaces. Value set to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes all classes from D up to the highest efficiency classes (A1-A4, B, C, D). Energy class is used because no consumption requirement was stated. The green-space preference is outside the available columns and is not filtered here.
